title: 第19章 洛冰儿讲解修炼境界等阶划分第20章 姬云生踏入炼气一重
content_zh:
姬云生一听点点头，陈晓云见状温柔笑着说道：“弟弟，你可要好好修炼哦！既然你能修炼的话，那你就先待在这里跟着师尊学习吧！我也该回去修炼了。”李雨彤见状笑着说道：“弟弟，加油，姐姐看好你哦！”然后拉着陈晓云就离去了，姬云生见状也是无语了，
洛冰儿也是无奈摇摇头，温柔说道：“那我接下来先教你修炼基础知识吧！”姬云生一听也是点点头，洛冰儿也是抱起他，开始温柔说道：“那我们就先来认识认识，修炼境界的划分，在苍玄大陆上，修炼者的境界分为：最低的炼气期，这个境界最主要的是，
为以后得修炼打基础，每一个小境界都需要修炼至极致，对以后的路才会走的更远。炼气期又分为九重小境界，等一个修炼者修炼至炼气九重圆满后，就可以开始尝试突破筑基了。当然了，这只是对于普通修炼者来说，如果你炼气九重圆满后，我建议你可以尝试打破极限。
因为炼气九重圆满后，不突破筑基的话，也能继续提升，这就是天骄走的路了，在打破炼气九重圆满后，会踏入炼气十重境界。一般来说，炼气十重境界的修士，就算没有筑基的修为，也是能堪比筑基初期的修士的。而炼气十重也不是最极限的境界，
像比一些大陆上名震大陆的天骄而言，他们至少在炼气期时，都达到最低十重。根据我知道的信息来说，炼气期有十二个小境界，但至少在一万多年来，没有一个天骄能踏入到炼气十二重。就以炼气九重突破十重的困难，就有十倍之多，而炼气十重到十一重的话，就是二十倍了，
而炼气十一重到十二重，那就是四十倍的困难了。我呢也不要求你能达到炼气十二重，只要你能达到炼气十一重，和我一样就可以了。”姬云生一听也是无语了，心里喃喃道：“卧槽了，你和我开玩笑呢？就这困难的倍数，还炼气十一重，我连自己现在是什么情况都不知道，
我就算想也没有那么容易突破啊。”洛冰儿又接着温柔说道：“当然了，要是没有突破的话，我也不怪你。能突破的话，还是要去尝试的，这对你以后很有好处。那我们接下来就先，大概说其他境界，炼气期后就到了筑基期了，筑基一重到四重为筑基初期，
五重到八重为筑基中期，九重到十二重为筑基后期，也可以说是筑基圆满了，不过也是要超过九重才算。筑基期的小境界的话，也是非常重要的一个阶段，不过相对于炼气期的十二重，而言就轻松多了。只要资源足够，哪怕是炼气九重圆满就突破筑基的修士，
只要炼气期打好稳固的修为，都能突破到筑基十二重。只是相对于那些打破，炼气期极限的天骄，困难程度提升了一些。一般来说炼气期九重突破至十重后，都能轻松修炼突破假丹期。炼气九重直接突破筑基，也能突破假丹，但唯一的缺憾是以后就很难达到渡劫期了。
更别提渡劫之后的境界了，当然也不是事实绝对，要是能在什么遗迹之中，获得大机缘的话，那也能稳固之前的根基，从而突破至更高的境界。筑基之后为假丹期，这个境界分为初期、中期、后期和圆满四个小境界。假丹圆满后，就到了金丹期，
这里就要多说一点了，到了金丹期的修士后，这里的小境界又分为九重了。而金丹期之后就是元婴期，一般而言这类修士的地位就高上很多了，至少开始算是大陆的看得过去的修士了。元婴期也同金丹期一样，分为九个小境界，而达到九重后，就开始踏入化神期了。
化神期也是九个小境界，元婴突破化神也不是一般的难，不仅仅需要渡雷劫，还需要掌握意境才能突破。没有掌握意境的修士，就算是元婴九重，只要没有掌握意境一天，化神期就像是天堑一般，无论如何都不能踏过去。元婴期突破化神是大陆上除根基外，最重要的阶段了，
有句话就是这样说的，不入化神终为蝼蚁。达到化神期的修士，在大陆上才能算上强者了，哪怕刚突破化神一重的修士，基本上都能相当于一千个元婴修士了。化神之上就达到了婴变期，这个境界也是九重小境界，这类的修士地位在大陆上，基本都是最少是强大势力的长老了。
当然了，我说的势力那至少都是，七品到九品势力了，如果是放在圣地的话，那就稍微差点了，只能是个执事之类的地位。而婴变期九重后就是渡劫期了，这个境界的修士，基本都是名震大陆的强者了，地位也是非常高了。渡劫期之后为大乘期，
而能达到这个境界的修士，相比较整个大陆，动一动都是震慑一方的强者。在大陆上每一个大乘期修士，都是举足轻重的地位，这个境界也分为九个小境界。不过嘛，在这里的话，就不同于大乘期之下的修士了，大乘期修士一重到九重圆满，
有句话是这么说的，一步一天地。大乘期修士每提升一重，那都是一个天地，就好比一个大乘期二重的修士，就相当于十名大乘期一重修士，每提升一重就翻一倍。而大乘期之后，还有境界，只要踏入那个境界半步后，就称之为大帝。
不过这类的强者，一般不会现世，因为他们都在寻求飞升之路，不过能不能飞升的话，就要看他们自己了。对于有些大帝来说，哪怕是自己所属势力被灭了，他都不会在乎的。毕竟能达到这一境界的，那都是尸山血海过来的，大帝一怒万古枯啊。”
content_en:
Ji Yunsheng nodded when he heard this. Chen Xiaoyun saw this and said with a gentle smile: "Brother, you have to practice hard! Since you can practice, then you should stay here to study with the master! It's time for me to go back to practice." Li Yutong saw this and said with a smile: "Brother, come on, my sister is taking good care of you!" Then he pulled Chen Xiaoyun and left. Ji Yunsheng was speechless when he saw this.
Luo Bing'er also shook her head helplessly and said softly: "Then let me teach you the basic knowledge of cultivation first!" Ji Yunsheng nodded when he heard this. Luo Bing'er also hugged him and began to say gently: "Then let's first get to know each other. The divisions of cultivation realms. On Cangxuan Continent, the realms of cultivators are divided into: the lowest Qi refining period. The most important thing about this realm is,
To lay the foundation for future cultivation, each small realm needs to be cultivated to the extreme, so that you can go further in the future. The Qi refining period is divided into nine minor realms. After a cultivator has reached the ninth level of Qi refining, he can start trying to break through and build a foundation. Of course, this is only for ordinary practitioners. If you have reached the ninth level of Qi refining, I suggest you try to break the limit.
Because after completing the ninth level of Qi refining, you can continue to improve without breaking through the foundation building. This is the path Tianjiao takes. After completing the ninth level of Qi refining, you will enter the tenth level of Qi refining. Generally speaking, monks at the tenth level of Qi refining, even if they don't have foundation-building skills, are comparable to monks in the early stages of foundation-building. And the tenth level of Qi refining is not the most extreme state.
For example, compared with some of the famous geniuses on the mainland, they all reached the lowest tenth level at least during the Qi refining stage. According to the information I know, there are twelve small realms in the Qi Refining Stage, but for at least ten thousand years, no genius has been able to reach the twelfth level of Qi Refining. Just using the ninth level of Qi refining to break through the tenth level is ten times more difficult, and if the tenth level of Qi refining is to the eleventh level, it is twenty times.
As for Qi refining from the eleventh to the twelfth level, it is forty times more difficult. I don’t require you to reach the 12th level of Qi refining. As long as you can reach the 11th level of Qi refining, just like me. "Ji Yunsheng was speechless upon hearing this, and murmured in his heart: "Damn it, are you kidding me? This is a multiple of difficulty and I am still at the eleventh level of Qi refining. I don’t even know what my current situation is.
Even if I wanted to, it wouldn't be that easy to break through. Luo Bing'er then said softly: "Of course, I wouldn't blame you if there is no breakthrough." If you can break through, you still have to try. This will be very beneficial to you in the future. Then let’s talk about other realms first. After the Qi refining stage, it’s the foundation building stage. The first to fourth levels of foundation building are the early stage of foundation building.
The fifth level to the eighth level is the middle stage of foundation building, and the ninth level to the twelfth level is the late stage of foundation building. It can also be said that the foundation building is complete, but it must exceed the ninth level. The small realm of the foundation building stage is also a very important stage, but compared to the twelfth level of the Qi refining stage, it is much easier. As long as there are enough resources, even a monk who has reached the ninth level of Qi Refining and can break through the Foundation Establishment,
As long as you build a solid cultivation base during the Qi refining period, you can break through to the twelfth level of foundation building. It's just that compared to those geniuses who have broken through the limits of the Qi refining period, the difficulty is a little higher. Generally speaking, after breaking through the ninth level to the tenth level during the Qi refining period, one can easily break through the false elixir period through cultivation. The ninth level of Qi Refining can directly break through the foundation building, and can also break through the fake elixir, but the only drawback is that it will be difficult to reach the tribulation stage in the future.
Not to mention the state after overcoming the tribulation, of course the truth is not absolute. If you can get a great opportunity in some ruins, it can also consolidate the previous foundation and break through to a higher state. After the foundation is established, there is the false elixir period, which is divided into four small realms: the early stage, the middle stage, the late stage and the consummation stage. After the false elixir is completed, it comes to the golden elixir stage.
Let me say a little more here. After reaching the Golden Core stage, the small realm here is divided into nine levels.. After the Golden Core Stage is the Nascent Soul Stage. Generally speaking, the status of such monks is much higher. At least they can be regarded as respectable monks in the mainland. The Nascent Soul stage is also divided into nine small realms like the Golden Elixir stage. After reaching the ninth level, it begins to enter the Divine Transformation stage.
The stage of transformation into gods is also nine small realms. It is not difficult for Yuanying to break through the transformation into gods. It not only needs to survive the thunder tribulation, but also needs to master the artistic conception to break through. For monks who have not mastered the artistic conception, even if they are at the ninth level of Nascent Soul, as long as they have not mastered the artistic conception for one day, the stage of transformation into gods will be like a chasm that cannot be crossed no matter what. The Nascent Soul stage, breaking through and becoming a god, is the most important stage on the mainland besides the foundation.
There is a saying that goes like this, if you don’t enter the realm of spiritual transformation, you will eventually become an ant. Only monks who have reached the stage of divine transformation can be considered strong on the mainland. Even those who have just broken through the first level of divine transformation are basically equivalent to a thousand Nascent Soul monks. The Infant Transformation Stage is reached above the level of God Transformation. This realm is also the ninth level minor realm. The status of such monks on the mainland is basically the elders of at least powerful forces.
Of course, the forces I'm talking about are at least seventh- to ninth-grade forces. If they were placed in the Holy Land, they would be a little less powerful and could only have a status like a deacon. After the ninth level of the Infant Transformation Stage, there is the Tribulation Stage. The monks at this stage are basically powerful men who are famous in the mainland, and their status is also very high. After the tribulation period is the Mahayana period.
Compared with the entire continent, monks who can reach this level are powerful men who can intimidate any other party. Every Mahayana monk on the mainland has a pivotal position, and this realm is also divided into nine small realms. However, here, it is different from the monks under the Mahayana stage. The monks in the Mahayana stage are perfect from the first level to the ninth level.
There is a saying that goes like this, one step at a time. Every time a Mahayana monk ascends to one level, it becomes a world, just like a second-level Mahayana monk is equivalent to ten first-level Mahayana monks, doubling each level. After the Mahayana stage, there is still a realm. As long as you take half a step into that realm, you will be called a great emperor.
However, this kind of powerful people generally do not appear in the world, because they are all looking for a way to ascend, but whether they can ascend depends on themselves. For some great emperors, they would not care even if their own forces were destroyed. After all, those who can reach this level have come from mountains of corpses and seas of blood. The emperor will wither forever in his anger. "
